_meta.name: tsoukalas_proved_38
_meta.description: The OEIS conjectures with published AlphaProof Nexus proof outputs: the released results repo ships exactly 38 Lean proof files, each proving a single conjecture (`target_theorem_0`).
_meta.derivation: One entry per proof file under APNOutputs/OEIS in the AlphaProof Nexus results repository.
_meta.note: Why 38 and not 44: the paper (arXiv 2605.13171) claims "proved 44/492 OEIS conjectures", but only 38 proofs were released. The 6-conjecture gap appears to be a paper miscount, or 6 proofs that were simply never published.
